2.200.14
RadialPointer.ToolTip
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialPointer.ToolTip element specifies the tooltip text for a RadialPointer. The element can
also be used to render alternative text (alt text) that is specified as an alt attribute in an HTML report.
The RadialPointer.ToolTip element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The following is the parent element of the RadialPointer.ToolTip element.
Parent elements
RadialPointer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialPointer.ToolTip element.
 <xsd:element name="Tooltip" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
